"""Exact-commit static A3 diagnostics; no MLIP, MD, provider calls, or tuning."""
import hashlib,importlib.metadata,json,platform,resource,subprocess,sys,time,traceback
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from pymatgen.core import Structure
from rhombus.domain.archetypes import ARCHETYPES,build_archetype_a3
from rhombus.transport.static_assessment import assess_vacancy_transport_a3
from rhombus.transport.bvse_percolation import build_softbv_evaluator,SpectatorSiteEnergyEvaluator,percolation_thresholds
from rhombus.qualification.electronic_insulation import assess_electronic_insulation
from rhombus.qualification.electrochemical_window import assess_electrochemical_window
from rhombus.atomistics.phase_stability_p1 import assess_phase_stability
from rhombus.pipeline.funnel import RhombusDiscoveryFunnel
root=Path.cwd();started=time.monotonic()
commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).decode().strip()
paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','rhombus/transport','rhombus/domain','rhombus/generation','rhombus/qualification','rhombus/pipeline','rhombus/atomistics/phase_stability_p1.py']).decode().splitlines()
report={'schema_version':'rhombus-static-a3-diagnostics-v1','executed_source_commit':commit,
 'executed_source_hashes':{p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths if p.endswith('.py')},
 'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'execution_started_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'runtime':{'python':sys.version,'architecture':platform.machine(),'packages':{p:importlib.metadata.version(p) for p in ('numpy','scipy','pymatgen','ase')},'device':'CPU','threads':2},
 'protocol':{'spacing_A':.22,'grid_dimension_cap':64,'mep_steps':1200,'endpoint_force_eV_A':1e-3,'band_force_eV_A':.03,
             'source_revision':'A3','references_revision':'A2','dilute_parent_limit':True,'model_applicability':'UNQUALIFIED'},
 'remote_science':'REMOTE_SCIENCE_NOT_EXECUTED','experimental_refinement_verified':False,'rows':[],
 'qualification':'ABSTAIN','provider_calls':0,'MLIP_calls':0,'MD_steps':0,'monetary_cost_usd':0}
for name in ARCHETYPES:
 t=time.monotonic();row={'name':name}
 try:
  info=build_archetype_a3(name,allow_idealized_completion=True);s=info.pop('structure');row.update(info);row['structure']=s.as_dict()
  comp={'composition':s.composition.element_composition.as_dict()}
  row['hull_prior']=assess_phase_stability(comp,reference_revision='A2')
  row['esw_prior']=assess_electrochemical_window(comp,reference_revision='A2',include_intrinsic=True,dilute_parent_limit=True)
  row['electronic_screen']=assess_electronic_insulation(s)
  r=assess_vacancy_transport_a3(s,defect=info['defect']);row['static']=r
  row['static_tier1_verdict']=RhombusDiscoveryFunnel._static_verdict({'P0':row['electronic_screen'],'P0_5':r,'P1':row['hull_prior']})
  # Independently reconstruct the retained band's evaluator from atom positions.
  probe=Structure.from_dict(r['expanded_probe_structure']) if 'expanded_probe_structure' in r else s.copy()
  if r['frenkel']['required']:
   probe.remove_sites([next(i for i,a in enumerate(probe) if a.specie.symbol=='Li')])
  nominal=np.array(r['mep']['endpoint_relaxations'][0]['nominal_position_A'])
  active=min((i for i,a in enumerate(probe) if a.specie.symbol=='Li'),key=lambda i:np.linalg.norm(probe[i].coords-nominal))
  assert np.linalg.norm(probe[active].coords-nominal)<1e-7
  evaluator=SpectatorSiteEnergyEvaluator(probe,active,build_softbv_evaluator(probe),periodic_cutoff_A=8.)
  e,f=evaluator(r['mep']['positions_A'])
  error=float(np.max(np.abs(e-r['mep']['energies_eV'])))
  assert error<1e-9
  row['numerical_verification']={'retained_band_energy_recomputation_max_error_eV':error,
      'endpoint_force_recomputation_eV_A':np.linalg.norm(f[[0,-1]],axis=1).tolist(),
      'active_index_in_vacancy_probe':active,'probe_atom_count':len(probe)}
  row['status']='COMPUTED_UNQUALIFIED_STATIC_MODEL'
  print(name,json.dumps({'channel':r['host_channel_barrier_3d_ev'],'hop':r['vacancy_migration_barrier_ev'],
    'F':r['frenkel']['site_energy_difference_eV'],'Eeff':r['effective_activation_barrier_ev'],
    'converged':r['mep']['converged'],'static':row['static_tier1_verdict']}),flush=True)
 except Exception as error:
  row.update(status='FAILED',error=repr(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc());print(name,'FAILED',repr(error),flush=True)
 row['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-t;report['rows'].append(row)
 Path('/tmp/rhombus-a3-benchmark-partial.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
# Explicit grid-sensitivity diagnostic, not a continuum convergence certificate.
gamma=build_archetype_a3('gamma_LiAlO2')['structure'];host=build_softbv_evaluator(gamma)
report['gamma_grid_sensitivity']={str(n):percolation_thresholds(host.grid(min_dimension=n,max_dimension=n))['barriers_eV']['3D'] for n in (24,32)}
report['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-started
report['observed_max_rss_KiB']=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
report['test_status_file']='/tmp/rhombus-a3-full-suite.log'
raw=(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n').encode();digest=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
Path('/tmp/rhombus-a3-benchmark.json').write_bytes(raw)
print('ARTIFACT_SHA256',digest,'SECONDS',report['elapsed_seconds'],flush=True)
